2608.01684.title: GABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Graph Analysis Tasks
2608.01684.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of planning, using tools, and interacting with external environments. They are typically supported by harnesses, which manage state and coordinate multi-step execution. Graph analysis provides a promising setting for evaluating their agentic capabilities, because it requires agents to access data and execute operations in a graph environment. However, existing graph benchmarks for LLMs provide limited coverage of graph tasks and graph types, making it difficult to comprehensively evaluate LLM agents. Moreover, they typically formulate graph analysis as text-based question answering, where graph information is directly provided in the prompt, limiting the evaluation of end-to-end agentic capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce GABench, a comprehensive benchmark for agentic graph analysis. GABench spans three graph types and covers four graph analysis task categories: graph retrieval, graph theory, graph machine learning, and graph open-ended question answering. GABench also provides 84 executable tools for accessing graph data and performing diverse graph operations. Building on these tools, we develop an agentic graph analysis task generation pipeline and construct 10,400 tasks with verifiable ground truth.Using GABench, we evaluate a range of frontier LLMs and agent harnesses. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (1) Existing LLM agents still struggle with complex graph analysis tasks. (2) Harness choice significantly affects performance, yet existing harnesses remain limited on complex graph tasks. (3) Graph analysis depends more on tool-call quality than quantity. Our findings provide practical insights into the development and evaluation of LLM agents for graph analysis.
2608.01684.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在計劃、使用工具和與外部環境互動方面的能力日益增強。<lb/>它們通常由鞍具支持，這些鞍具管理狀態並協調多步執行。<lb/>圖形分析為評估其代理能力提供了一個有前途的環境，因為它要求代理訪問數據並在圖形環境中執行操作。<lb/>然而，現有的 LLM 圖形基準對圖形任務和圖形類型的覆蓋範圍有限，這使得全面評估 LLM 代理變得困難。<lb/>此外，它們通常將圖形分析表述為基於文本的問題回答，其中圖形信息直接在提示中提供，限制了端到端代理能力的評估。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們引入了 GABench，一個全面的代理圖形分析基準。<lb/>GABench 涉及三種圖形類型，並涵蓋四個圖形分析任務類別：圖形檢索、圖形理論、圖形機器學習和圖形開放式問題回答。<lb/>GABench 還提供 84 種可執行工具，用於訪問圖形數據和執行多樣的圖形操作。<lb/>基於這些工具，我們開發了一個代理圖形分析任務生成管道，並構建了 10,400 個具有可驗證真實性的任務。<lb/>使用 GABench，我們評估了一系列前沿 LLM 和代理鞍具。<lb/>我們的實驗揭示了三個關鍵發現：（1）現有的 LLM 代理在複雜的圖形分析任務中仍然掙扎。<lb/>（2）鞍具的選擇顯著影響性能，但現有的鞍具在複雜圖形任務上仍然有限。<lb/>（3）圖形分析更依賴於工具調用的質量而非數量。<lb/>我們的發現為 LLM 代理在圖形分析中的發展和評估提供了實用的見解。
